whisper.label: Whisper Large-V3
whisper.text: Another one of Sharon's hottest holograms is this 3D CD cover she did for rock superstar Prince. Yeah, Prince was a great, great person to work with. He showed me a lot of respect for what I was doing. One of the things that makes this medium hard is that the talent has to move very slowly, like Tai Chi motion, very slow. But I'm blessed doing sports and entertainment figures who just have a great kinesthetic sense, which is awareness of their body in space. And when I say a little slower, they do what I ask, and it makes me look good. And rolling. So that's the color of the original little shot by McCormick. And here's the black and white print that was used to make the first holograms of this full size, and then the reductions happen afterwards. Little Little Little Little Little Little Little Little Little Little Little Little Little
